feature_specs.name: relative_s
feature_specs.description: Ego s minus opponent s; shortest signed gap on a closed track.

feature_specs.name: relative_d
feature_specs.description: Ego d minus opponent d; positive means ego is to the left.

feature_specs.name: relative_speed
feature_specs.description: Ego scalar vehicle speed minus opponent scalar vehicle speed.

feature_specs.name: opponent_d
feature_specs.description: Current opponent d relative to the shared centerline; left is positive.

target_spec.name: opponent_delta_d
target_spec.description: Opponent d at t + horizon minus opponent d at t.
